description: Extend the main attribute macro to generate a build manifest containing the parsed contents of the macro. This manifest will be used to provision necessary resources before deployment, enabling better resource management and deployment preparation.
functional_requirements: Modify the main attribute macro to output a structured build manifest when invoked
Ensure the build manifest includes all parsed configuration and resource declarations from the macro
Make the manifest available to the deployment system for pre-deployment resource provisioning
Maintain backward compatibility with existing shuttle deployments and CLI commands
